property.title: 5-bedroom penthouse for sale
property.description: Penthouse | 346m² Interior | 548m² Total Covered Area | 248m² roof garden. Crowning the pinnacle of a world-class residential development, this exceptional penthouse represents the finest in contemporary Mediterranean living. Set above Souni with sweeping, uninterrupted views of the coastline below, this is a residence that simply cannot be replicated. This is you own entire private floor, accessable via a private lift. With 346m² of meticulously designed interior space, 103m² of covered terrace, and a generous 248m² private garden, the total covered area reaches an impressive 546m². Every square metre has been conceived for those who refuse to compromise. Your own private elevator gives on you access to your penthouse. The penthouse is appointed throughout with the best of European craftsmanship. Italian flooring and lighting set the tone from the moment you enter, while Italian bathroom and kitchen design deliver both beauty and precision engineering. German sanitary ware ensures lasting quality where it matters most, and Swedish-engineered windows frame the extraordinary panoramic views of Souni and the Mediterranean coastline — flooding every room with natural light. There is no better vantage point in the development. Elevated above everything, the covered terrace and garden become a private outdoor sanctuary — yours alone, with the sea stretching out before you.
